mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 20-day returns as consumer spending expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns through improved corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive returns in > 50% of cases over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL inflation > 2.5% annually) dampens liquidity and raises discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,100 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for residential construction, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through accelerated economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% generates immediate liquidity effects that produce positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through short-term market sentiment shifts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.0% in the prior quarter signals sustained economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through prolonged corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 150,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 5-day returns through accelerated consumer spending and retail sector growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000.
